description: Plan, publish, and schedule social media posts with Posteady from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Posteady is a social media scheduling tool. Use it to write, schedule, and publish posts to your social media accounts from a conversation, so you can reach your audience on every platform from one place.

With Posteady you can:
- Publish posts now or schedule them for later on your connected accounts, including thread chains on X and Threads
- See your connected social accounts and workspaces
- Review your recent posts and their performance, such as views and likes
- Create carousels from a topic, text, or link, with Posteady writing and designing the slides
- Save images you attach to the conversation and post them to Threads as an image post or carousel
- Post images and videos from your Posteady media library to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and Facebook Pages
- Repost your recent posts on Threads, X, and LinkedIn
- Review your scheduled posts, check whether a post went out, and cancel posts that are not published yet

Supported platforms include Threads, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, and Facebook Pages.

You need a Posteady account with at least one connected social account. Posteady only accesses the workspaces, accounts, posts, and media your Posteady account can use. Images you save or upload to Posteady get links that anyone with the link can open.
capabilities: Create carousels from a topic or link
Save chat images for Threads posts
defaultPrompt: Which social accounts do I have connected in Posteady?
Draft a Threads, X, and LinkedIn post announcing our launch for Monday at 10:00.
Show me everything I have scheduled for the next two weeks.

positive.description: Read recent Threads posts and their metrics from the review workspace. Read-only.
positive.prompt: Using Posteady, show my 5 most recent Threads posts and tell me which one has the most views.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists up to 5 recent posts from the connected Threads test account in the ChatGPT Review workspace, with their synced metrics, and names the post with the most views. Nothing is published or changed.

positive.description: Publish a text post to the connected Threads test account.
positive.prompt: Post this to my Threads account with Posteady now: "Quick test from ChatGPT: planning this week's posts."
positive.expected_behavior: After the user confirms the action, publish_post publishes one text post to the Threads test account and returns the post link. Each run creates one new post, so the case can be repeated.

positive.description: Schedule a Threads post for a relative time, check the queue, and cancel it.
positive.prompt: Schedule a Threads post for tomorrow at 10 AM saying "Weekly tip: plan your posts a week ahead." Then show my scheduled posts and cancel the one you just scheduled.
positive.expected_behavior: Schedules the post for tomorrow at 10:00 AM in the workspace time zone (America/Chicago), shows it in the scheduled list, and then cancels it. After cancellation the post is no longer queued and nothing is published.

positive.description: Repost one of the account's recent Threads posts.
positive.prompt: Find my most recent Threads post that hasn't been reposted yet and repost it with Posteady.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks a recent post from the Threads test account, reposts it to the same account's feed, and confirms. If that post was already reposted in an earlier run, Posteady returns ALREADY_REPOSTED and ChatGPT offers to repost a different post.

positive.description: Save an image attached to the conversation to the Posteady media library and publish it as a Threads image post. Download the sample image from the attachment URL (or use any JPEG or PNG) and attach it to the message.
positive.prompt: Use Posteady to post the attached image to my Threads account with the caption "New week, new plan."
positive.expected_behavior: save_chat_images saves the attached image and returns a mediaId. After the user confirms, publish_post publishes one Threads image post with the caption and returns the post link. The saved image also appears in the workspace's media library.

negative.description: Deleting a published post is not supported. Posteady has no delete tool, so nothing should be changed.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT explains that Posteady can't delete published posts and suggests deleting it in the Threads app. No Posteady write tool is called.

negative.description: The requested platform is not connected in the review workspace, so Posteady should not publish anywhere else instead.
negative.prompt: Post "Hello from ChatGPT" to my TikTok account.
negative.expected_behavior: list_accounts shows only the Threads test account. ChatGPT says no TikTok account is connected in Posteady and does not publish to Threads or any other account.

negative.description: Sending direct messages is outside Posteady's tools, so the request should be declined.
negative.prompt: Send a direct message to @openai on Threads saying "hi".
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT explains that Posteady can't send direct messages and does not publish a post instead.

publication.release_notes: Updates the directory listing: the subtitle is now "Social media scheduler", with a clearer description, the new Posteady logo, and starter prompts. No changes to tools, permissions, or data handling.

ko-KR.subtitle: SNS 콘텐츠 기획부터 예약 발행까지
ko-KR.description:
Posteady는 SNS 예약 발행 도구입니다. 대화로 SNS 계정에 올릴 글을 쓰고, 예약하고, 발행해서 모든 플랫폼의 팔로워에게 한곳에서 닿을 수 있습니다.

Posteady로 할 수 있는 일:
- 연결된 계정에 글을 바로 발행하거나 예약합니다. X와 Threads에서는 이어지는 글(스레드)도 올립니다.
- 연결된 SNS 계정과 워크스페이스를 확인합니다.
- 최근 게시물과 조회수·좋아요 같은 성과를 봅니다.
- 주제·글·링크로 카드뉴스를 만듭니다. 문구와 디자인은 Posteady가 맡습니다.
- 대화에 첨부한 이미지를 저장해 Threads 이미지 글이나 캐러셀로 올립니다.
- Posteady 미디어 라이브러리의 이미지·영상을 Instagram·TikTok·YouTube·Facebook 페이지에 올립니다.
- 최근 게시물을 Threads·X·LinkedIn에 리포스트합니다.
- 예약된 글을 확인하고, 발행됐는지 보고, 아직 발행되지 않은 글을 취소합니다.

지원 플랫폼: Threads, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook 페이지.

연결된 SNS 계정이 하나 이상 있는 Posteady 계정이 필요합니다. Posteady는 내 Posteady 계정이 쓸 수 있는 워크스페이스·계정·게시물·미디어에만 접근합니다. Posteady에 저장하거나 올린 이미지는 링크를 아는 누구나 열 수 있습니다.
